Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vindication **(सत्यापन): The action of clearing someone of blame or suspicion.

 
 
• **Example:** The new evidence led to the vindication of the wrongly accused man.
 
 
 
• **Concentrate **(ध्यान केंद्रित करना ): To focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity.
 
 
• **Example: **She needs to concentrate on her studies to excel in her exams.
 
 
 
• **Psychometric** (मनोमितीय): Relates to the field of study concerned with the theory and technique of psychological measurement.
 
 
• **Example:** Psychometric tests are often used in recruitment to assess candidates' suitability for a role.
